name: 66967 · Smith Center, KS
findings: ZIP 66967 (Smith Center) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66967 (Smith Center) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
89% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66967 (Smith Center) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
